newsitem.title: CANADA: Cominco Trail lead plant seen operational.
newsitem.headline: Cominco Trail lead plant seen operational.

text.p: Cominco Ltd said on Thursday its new lead plant at Trail, British Columbia, would likely be fully operational in the second half of 1997.
"We would hope that some time in the second half things would be finished," Cominco Chief Executive David Thompson told the annual meeting..
Thompson said that the Trail facility furnace was operating at more than 50 percent of design feed rate with a charge of lead concentrate and recycled slag.
The plant, which began processing feed material on March 31, had already produced more than 1,500 tonnes of lead bullion, Thompson said.
Start-up operations at the 120,000-tonne per load facility had progressed smoothly with only a few minor problems, he said.

The C$160 million plant, which replaces the company's 50-year-old facility at Trail, would improve operating profits by about $30 million annually, through reduced costs and increased capacity, Cominco said.
